name: Historical DPRK IT-worker dispatching-structure map
caveats: Attribute the map to the 2022 interagency advisory.

Foreign contractors, customers, local companies, schools, universities, jurisdictions, networks, and service providers require direct evidence before treatment as knowing participants.
Represent state structures as organizational context; a commercial front-company label requires a separate source.

This describes the U.S. government's May 2022 assessment. Later organizational restructuring or changes require separate evidence.
This is a historical, source-qualified program-level finding; current census and person, organization, jurisdiction, platform-user or technology-user status require current sources.

infrastructure.statement: The advisory says the 313 General Bureau of the Munitions Industry Department deploys a majority of the DPRK IT workforce overseas. It also identifies the Ministry of Atomic Energy Industry, military entities subordinate to the Ministry of Defense and Korean People's Army, the DPRK Education Commission's Foreign Trade Office, and the Pyongyang Information Technology Bureau of the Workers' Party Central Committee's Science and Education Department as dispatching or associated structures.
